Line 270: `noDocs: cli.noDocs || isTruthy(process.env.ADHD_NO_DOCS)`. isTruthy handles '1', 'true', 'yes'. When --no-docs is passed (cli.noDocs=true), it wins via ||. When not passed (false), env is checked. Minor note: there's no way to explicitly set noDocs=false from CLI to override a truthy env var, but this is standard for boolean-only flags. Tests verify ADHD_NO_DOCS=1 and =true work, and CLI precedence is confirmed.

overallSummary: Sprint 2 is well-implemented. All four features (Harness Orchestration Integration, --no-docs CLI Flag, Per-Agent Model Override for Documenter, Documenter Git Commit) are correctly implemented with proper code structure. The documenter is invoked from runSprintLoop (shared by both fresh and resume paths), gated by allPassed && !config.noDocs, wrapped in try/catch for resilience, with tracing span, usage recording, git commit enforcement, and skills routing all present. CLI/env parsing follows established patterns with correct precedence. Tests cover config/CLI parsing, structural analysis of harness.ts, skills routing, and documenter prompt generation. All 246 relevant tests pass (1 pre-existing failure unrelated to Sprint 2).
